opening.argument: The video presents practical ways for consumers to obtain Uber credits and reduced ride costs through ordinary promotions and card benefits. Its stated focus is clear from the description: “My top ways to get free Uber credits towards your next ride.” The referral discussion explains that users can share a code, giving a new participant five dollars off the first four rides while the code owner receives a five-dollar Uber credit. It also describes 5% cashback redeemable for Uber credits at participating stores when an eligible Visa card is used, along with the Amex Platinum benefit of a $200 Uber credit allocated monthly and in December. These are presented as participation conditions and consumer guidance, not as requests to send money or private credentials to the presenter. The offers may not all remain current, but that limitation does not change the ordinary rewards-based purpose.
